About.description2: Our engineers work from European time zones with significant overlap with both EU and US business hours. We speak your language—literally and technically—and treat your codebase like our own.

project.title: Project-Based

start.question: How quickly can you start?
start.answer: We typically start within 48 hours of our initial consultation. Our process is streamlined to get us integrated with your team as fast as possible.

timezone.question: Do you work in my time zone?
timezone.answer: Yes, we are based in the EU but work across US and European time zones. We ensure at least 4 hours of overlap with your core working hours.

pricing.question: What is your pricing model?
pricing.answer: We offer both staff augmentation (hourly/monthly rates) and project-based fixed pricing, depending on your needs. Contact us for a detailed quote.

pm.question: Do you provide Project Managers?
pm.answer: Yes, if needed. However, our senior engineers are self-organizing and capable of working directly with your product owners.

hero.label: Security & Compliance
hero.title: Security by Design
hero.subtitle: We don’t bolt security on at the end. It’s baked into every commit, every container, and every cloud resource we touch.

compliance.title: Compliance & Standards
compliance.description: Our internal processes are designed to align with the frameworks that matter to you. While we are an engineering partner, not a hosting provider, we operate with the rigor of a regulated entity.

gdpr.title: GDPR Compliant
gdpr.text: All our engineers and operations are based in the EU/EEA or equivalent jurisdictions. Data Protection Agreements (DPA) are standard in every engagement.

iso.title: ISO 27001 Aligned
iso.text: We follow information security management best practices, including documented access controls, incident response plans, and asset management.

soc2.title: SOC2 Readiness
soc2.text: For US clients, we align with SOC2 Trust Services Criteria. We implement change management, logical access, and monitoring controls by default.

aws.title: Cloud Security
aws.text: We use AWS/GCP best practices: Well-Architected Framework, least-privilege IAM roles, and separate VPCs for environments.

encryption.title: Encryption Everywhere
encryption.text: Data is encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.2+). We manage secrets using enterprise-grade vaults (AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault).

access.title: Zero Trust Access
access.text: No VPNs, no shared passwords. We access infrastructure via short-lived credentials and identity-aware proxies.

review.title: Mandatory Peer Review
review.text: No code reaches production without at least one senior engineer approval. We check for OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities during review.

scanning.title: Automated Scanning
scanning.text: CI/CD pipelines include SAST (Static Analysis), DAST (Dynamic Analysis), and specialized dependency scanning to catch vulnerabilities early.

supply.title: Supply Chain Security
supply.text: We pin dependency versions, use signed commits, and regularly audit third-party libraries for CVEs.

cta.title: Have specific compliance needs?
cta.text: We are happy to discuss our security protocols and align with your vendor assessment requirements.
